name: Undertaking Status Reason
definition: Specifies the reason for the status or for the action (for instance settlement reason).

DemandRefusalStatusReason.name: Demand Refusal Status Reason
DemandRefusalStatusReason.definition: Processing status reported by the issuer for the refusal of a demand.

SettlementReason.name: Settlement Reason
SettlementReason.definition: Specifies the reason for the settlement of an amount.

Discrepancy.name: Discrepancy
Discrepancy.definition: Demand is refused because of a discrepancy in the demand.

UndertakingStatus.name: Undertaking Status
UndertakingStatus.definition: Status for which a reason is provided. It is derived from the association between StatusReason and Status.
